📉 What moved today, Thursday 19 November

🏦 The Reserve Bank kept the repo rate at 7.25%, so prime stays at 10.75%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.4% lower at 98,385, a fifth losing day. Resource shares rose 1.2%, while banks and insurers fell 1.2%.

💱 The rand weakened further, to about R17.47 to the dollar. Brent oil rose 1.3% to about $93.14, and gold fell 0.9% to about $3,687.

What it means for you: your loan repayments stay the same for now, but a weaker rand and dearer oil put pressure on December's expected petrol cut.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
